post.caption: Breakfast at Tiffany's began at dawn. On Sunday, October 2, 1960, a crew set up on Fifth Avenue, and Audrey Hepburn stood outside the Tiffany store in the very first scene filmed for the movie. Hubert de Givenchy designed her black gown, and the five strands of pearls around her neck were made by the Parisian jeweler Roger Scemama, not by Tiffany. For publicity photos, Hepburn wore the 128.54 carat Tiffany Diamond in a ribbon necklace by Jean Schlumberger. One of her Givenchy dresses sold for 467,200 pounds in 2006.
